subject: [hw] opus-lead: q10jx BUILD BREAK - 0311 autotest calls n2vc_acquire_locked with 3 args (K02 now takes 4: ven_slow)
body: K02 slow-default edit (17:14) changed n2vc_acquire_locked(blk, f, hidden, ven_slow) (nord2_vcodec.inc:549/553). kern/p031x/bsd/dev/nord2_vcodec_at.inc:194 and :198 still pass 3 args -> 0311 does not compile. Fix (opus-kern owns at.inc): add a 4th arg `false` to both calls: the autotest step 1 already sets venc_sel itself (bit 9 knob) before acquiring, so acquire must not re-mux. Run kern/p031x/test/run_tests.sh + make_series.sh, then the staged sweet_touch compile before packing q10jx. Also nice-to-have (no blocker): K02 log one line when n2vc_venc_mux switches (e.g. "NORD2 VCODEC: venc_sel %#x -> %#x (273 MHz)") so the phone log proves the clock; FIRST_PHONE_TEST.md expects it. q10jx must contain ONLY q10jw + this K02 change (no DEC04/DEC07 VDEC_ALL window).
